name: DaxLib.SVG.Viz.Heatmap
description: Renders a heatmap as an SVG data URI showing data density using kernel density estimation

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Optional color for high density areas. Defaults to Power BI theme color

code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Viz.Heatmap' =
		(
			axisRef: ANYREF EXPR,
			measureRef: NUMERIC EXPR,
			color: STRING,
			width: INT64,
			height: INT64
		) =>

			VAR _W = IF( ISBLANK( width ), 120, width )
			VAR _H = IF( ISBLANK( height ), 48, height )
			VAR _Color = IF( NOT ISBLANK( color ), color, DaxLib.SVG.Color.Theme( "Power BI", 1 ) )
			VAR _Marks =
				DaxLib.SVG.Compound.Heatmap(
					0, 0, _W, _H, 0, 0,
					axisRef, measureRef, 50, 1, _Color
				)

			RETURN
				IF( NOT ISBLANK( _Marks ), DaxLib.SVG.SVG( "100%", "100%", "0 0 " & _W & " " & _H, _Marks, BLANK() ) )
